gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-montserrat-un: Montserrat Underline has round bowls drawn like bent wire. Ethnocentric, wide-tracked and low-slung, brings the speed, and that sharp split between the two is what makes the pairing stick.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-mozilla-headl: Fast and aggressive up top, Ethnocentric spreads its short-ascender letters wide apart. Mozilla Headline follows with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, so a longer passage feels friendly and current.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-mozilla-text: Neutral in temperament, Mozilla Text stacks tall lowercase bodies and flared terminals beneath the stretched-out Ethnocentric heading. Long reading feels sturdy.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-nata-sans: Ethnocentric's big bowls and short ascenders look built for speed. Nata Sans answers with a marker-like constant line and wide, unclosed curves, and that steadiness against the heading's aggression is the pair's best trick.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-nobile: Ethnocentric throws its letters wide and fast, with big bowls under short ascenders. Nobile does the quieter job, holding capitals close to the x-height with open mouths that read smoothly in sans-serif fashion.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-nokora: Nokora lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, with an s that never tightens up. Over a longer stretch it stays approachable.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-kufi-ara: Ethnocentric pushes its wide-set, bowl-heavy letters forward with real speed. And Noto Kufi Arabic settles underneath, its open c and low capitals giving the sans-serif text a modern, tidy footing.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-sans: Ethnocentric stretches its short-ascender letters wide and fast, with big bowls that glide through without clogging. Noto Sans keeps long reading smooth.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-sans-adl: Noto Sans Adlam reads clean, with tall, full c, s and z shapes. Ethnocentric earns its keep big and short, where its wide tracking and heavy bowls can sprint across the line.

Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined feels professional and modern. Ethnocentric is best at fast, wide-tracked display punch, while the sans below it excels at generous curve spacing and a small gap between cases.
